sections.overview:
This skill teaches the fundamentals of getting your website onto Google's first page without paying for ads. It covers how Google's search algorithms work, how to identify high-performing keywords using Google's search suggestions, and how to optimize landing pages with proper title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and content structure. The guide explains that ranking can happen quickly—sometimes within 24 hours—by creating pages that answer the questions people search for. It's designed for website owners and marketers who want sustainable organic rankings through SEO best practices rather than paid advertising.
Small business owners wanting to increase organic traffic without ad spend
Content creators targeting multi-word keywords with lower competition
Website owners optimizing landing pages for better search visibility
Digital marketers learning to use Google's related searches for keyword research
